Procedure Name.value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine 2D Mapping v1

Procedure Author.value: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.

Laboratory.value: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method
Procedure Reference(s).value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (2D map) — "2D trace element mapping of olivine crystals" (p.1); the reported dataset is "seven 2D element maps of PMG olivine crystals", filtered and median-smoothed before analysis (p.6)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (2D map)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: PMG thick sections polished; HELEX II two-volume cell; C-coated for SEM then coating removed before LA
Sample Preparation Method.value: PMG thick sections polished; HELEX II two-volume cell; C-coated for SEM then coating removed before LA

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: N (mapping; surface effects average out over large area)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim, sited on a prior μXRF survey — "The locations for LA-ICP-MS mapping were selected to be close to the metal-olivine rims of large olivine crystals with the laser beam rastering from the olivine rim in the direction of the olivine core", at locations "indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim, sited on a prior μXRF survey

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited — Fe Kα intensity maps identify the mineral phases "based on the intensities of the Kα lines of the constituent major elements (Fe, Mg, Ni, Cr, S, Ca and P)", and the LA-ICP-MS areas correspond "to the locations indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4). The instrument is a Bruker M4 Tornado with a Rh-anode source at 50 kV and 150 μA, focused to "a 25 μm spot (measured for Mo Kα)" (p.3)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)

ICP-MS Type.cell: Double-focusing sector field ICP-MS (explicitly stated: "Thermo Scientific Element XR double-focusing sector field ICP-MS unit")
ICP-MS Type.value: Double-focusing sector field ICP-MS (explicitly stated: "Thermo Scientific Element XR double-focusing sector field ICP-MS unit")

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)

Laser Wavelength and Type.cell: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
Laser Wavelength and Type.value: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns

Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only).cell: 20 µm (contiguous; 20×20 µm square spot = line spacing equals spot width)
Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only).value: 20 µm (contiguous; 20×20 µm square spot = line spacing equals spot width)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar make-up: 0.81–0.99 l min⁻¹ (mapping); N₂ explicitly not added
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: Ar make-up: 0.81–0.99 l min⁻¹ (mapping); N₂ explicitly not added

Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.cell: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.81 l min⁻¹ (mapping)
Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.value: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.81 l min⁻¹ (mapping)

Plasma Thermal Mode.cell: Cool plasma (800 W RF) to reduce Ar-based argide interferences on ⁶⁰Ni and ⁷¹Ga

Signal Smoothing.cell: None (no signal smoothing device; N₂ not added)
Signal Smoothing.value: None (no signal smoothing device; N₂ not added)

ICP Tuning.cell: Daily tuning; cool plasma conditions optimized; N₂ explicitly not added to avoid N-based interferences
ICP Tuning.value: Daily tuning; cool plasma conditions optimized; N₂ explicitly not added to avoid N-based interferences

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: ThO⁺/Th⁺ (mass 248/232); threshold not explicitly stated but minimized by cool plasma
Oxide Production Method and Threshold.value: ThO⁺/Th⁺ (mass 248/232); threshold not explicitly stated but minimized by cool plasma

Analysis Sequence.cell: (i) Gas blanks → (ii) all glass GRMs for external calibration → (iii) 1–3 cosmic spherule unknowns → (iv) blanks → (v) all glass GRMs again
Analysis Sequence.value: (i) Gas blanks → (ii) all glass GRMs for external calibration → (iii) 1–3 cosmic spherule unknowns → (iv) blanks → (v) all glass GRMs again

Target Species.cell: ²⁵Mg, ²⁷Al, ²⁹Si, ³¹P, ⁴⁵Sc, ⁵¹V, ⁵³Cr, ⁵⁵Mn, ⁵⁷Fe, ⁶⁰Ni, ⁷¹Ga, ¹³⁹La, ¹⁵³Eu, ¹⁹⁵Pt (14 nuclides)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Two-dimensional concentration maps per element (µg/g) for the mapped olivine crystals, held as "2D concentration matrices of all target elements" (p.5); the paper also reports the fayalite content "(fayalite, Fa # = FeO/(FeO + MgO) ∙ 100, atomic %)" from the μXRF data alongside (Table 1, p.5), and principal-component scores derived from seven normalised maps (p.6)

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: 0.01 s (10 ms) per nuclide; samples per peak: 10; duty cycle time: 1.944 s (14 nuclides)

Background Count Time.cell: Scans for gas blank: 10 per line (before each mapping line); 80 scans during ablation
Background Count Time.value: Scans for gas blank: 10 per line (before each mapping line); 80 scans during ablation

Number of Replicates.cell: N (single map per olivine crystal section per sample)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Sum-of-major-oxide normalization: MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ = 100 wt% per pixel (Liu et al. 2008 approach; no EPMA required for IS)

value.value: MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ = 100 wt% per pixel (Liu et al. 2008 approach; no EPMA required for IS)

Internal Standard Element.cell: No single IS element; oxide sum normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅) used as virtual IS per pixel

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: Internal normalization to MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ oxide sum corrects for point-to-point ablation yield variation; additional pixel-by-pixel normalization fixes oxide sum to 100 wt%

Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF).cell: N (oxide sum normalization approach is inherently matrix-independent within olivine composition range)

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Manual visual inspection of time-resolved signal per line; anomalous spikes (inclusions, cracks, veinlets) excluded; P-rich veinlet regions identified and excluded from olivine averages
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Manual visual inspection of time-resolved signal per line; anomalous spikes (inclusions, cracks, veinlets) excluded; P-rich veinlet regions identified and excluded from olivine averages

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Manual identification and exclusion of P-rich veinlet pixels from olivine averages; anomalous spikes from inclusions excluded per line
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Manual identification and exclusion of P-rich veinlet pixels from olivine averages; anomalous spikes from inclusions excluded per line

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank measured before each ablation line (10 scans of gas blank per mapping line); average background subtracted from each corresponding ablation line
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank measured before each ablation line (10 scans of gas blank per mapping line); average background subtracted from each corresponding ablation line

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: Applied: triple mode detection; cross-calibration between pulse-counting and analog modes performed

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — cool plasma conditions (800 W) applied to reduce argide-based interferences (³⁶Ar²⁴Mg⁺ on ⁶⁰Ni; ⁴⁰Ar³¹P⁺ on ⁷¹Ga); oxide-based interferences minimized by dry plasma and tuning; mathematical corrections in some cases (Table C1)

Interfering Species.cell: Per Table C1: ¹²C¹³C⁺ on ²⁵Mg; ¹⁵N¹⁶O⁺ on ³¹P; ²⁹Si¹⁶O⁺ on ⁴⁵Sc; ³⁵Cl¹⁶O⁺ on ⁵¹V; ⁴⁰Ar¹³C⁺ on ⁵³Cr; ⁴⁰Ar¹⁵N⁺ on ⁵⁵Mn; ⁴⁰Ar¹⁶OH⁺ on ⁵⁷Fe; ⁴⁴Ca¹⁶O⁺ and ²⁴Mg³⁶Ar⁺ on ⁶⁰Ni; ³¹P⁴⁰Ar⁺ and ⁵⁵Mn¹⁶O⁺ on ⁷¹Ga; ¹³⁷Ba¹⁶O⁺ on ¹⁵³Eu (most significant interferences in bold)

Interference Correction Method.cell: Physical mitigation: cool plasma (800 W RF) reduces ³⁶Ar²⁴Mg⁺ on ⁶⁰Ni, ⁴⁰Ar³¹P⁺ on ⁷¹Ga by >90%; oxide interferences minimized by dry plasma conditions; background subtraction corrects for time-invariant Ar-based interferences; mathematical corrections applied where feasible per Appendix C4

value.value: cool plasma (800 W RF) reduces ³⁶Ar²⁴Mg⁺ on ⁶⁰Ni, ⁴⁰Ar³¹P⁺ on ⁷¹Ga by >90%

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: Gas blank measured before each ablation line; adequate washout ensured by duty cycle timing
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: Gas blank measured before each ablation line; adequate washout ensured by duty cycle timing

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: 100% oxide sum normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅) applied per pixel after IS-normalized external calibration (equations 3–4 in Appendix C1) to fix final mass balance

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — whole results are dropped, but on signal grounds: "where significant spikes in individual transient LA-ICP-MS signals were observed (e.g. Ca in CMS 04071 and Seymchan and Ni in Brahin and Seymchan), results were not included in Table 1" (p.6). By basis that belongs to Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach; no result-based selection rule is stated. For the maps, "The P-rich veinlets were excluded from the maps prior to the calculation of the correlation coefficients" (appendix C), which masks pixels within a result rather than admitting or excluding results

Combination Method.cell: all: average over the map pixels after masking the P-rich veinlets ('pure' olivine) — Fig. 4: 'to cancel out the input of the P2O5-rich veinlets to obtain average “pure” olivine values'

value.value: average over the map pixels after masking the P-rich veinlets ('pure' olivine)

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: Multiple glass GRMs used together for linear regression external calibration: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G (synthetic), USGS GSE-1G (synthetic), USGS BHVO-2G, USGS BIR-1G (natural basalt glasses)

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Each GRM analyzed 3–5× before and 3–5× after sample analyses (all GRMs at start and end of session)
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Each GRM analyzed 3–5× before and 3–5× after sample analyses (all GRMs at start and end of session)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: MPI-DING glasses: GOR132-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G; USGS: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G — measured as unknowns alongside samples and compared to GeoReM preferred values (Table 1 and Section 3.3)

Detection Limit.cell: LODs reported in Table E1 (Appendix E) for 2D mapping: average of all individual pixel LODs (Na=1, Nb=10 per Longerich et al. 1996)

members: LODs reported in Table E1 (Appendix E) for 2D mapping
value.value: average of all individual pixel LODs (Na=1, Nb=10 per Longerich et al. 1996)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: Intermediate precision for mapping: most elements at ≥10 µg g⁻¹: 5–15% RSD; elements <10 µg g⁻¹: 5–30% RSD; assessed from repeated GRM mapping in 8 sessions over 1 year (n=8 for each element)

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: No systematic bias demonstrated; MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ oxide sums after mapping varied 95–99 wt% (average near 100%); LA-ICP-MS Fa# values compared to EMPA values for 8 PMG (Fig. 5A shows good agreement)

Additional Notes.cell: Pallasite olivine 2D mapping in cool plasma mode (800 W) is a core methodological innovation; total of 8 PMG meteorites mapped; P-rich veinlets excluded from olivine averages; Fa# values verified against EMPA (Fig. 5A)
Additional Notes.value: Pallasite olivine 2D mapping in cool plasma mode (800 W) is a core methodological innovation; total of 8 PMG meteorites mapped; P-rich veinlets excluded from olivine averages; Fa# values verified against EMPA (Fig. 5A)
